post.originalText:
Seedance 2.0 cinematic slice-of-life, 30 seconds, 16:9.

"img" = Main Subject. Preserve her exact face, identity, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, black cord necklace, black wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and messy ponytail throughout. Outfit: olive-green faded sleeveless crop top for the first half, grey faded sleeveless crop top for the second half, loose high-waist light-blue jeans, black canvas sneakers.

Authentic Indonesian woman. Early-2000s Indonesian neighborhood.

Visual style: Extremely raw handheld DV camcorder footage. Gritty home-video realism, heavy handheld movement, micro-shakes, imperfect framing, frequent reframing, partial cropping, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure fluctuations, rolling shutter, motion blur, low contrast, faded colors, washed highlights, digital noise and compression artifacts. No stabilization, posing, commercial look, glamour, modern grading, or perfect composition.

00:00–00:03 — Sitting on a concrete sidewalk, casually fixing her ponytail with both hands. Soft smile. Camera drifts and struggles with focus.

00:03–00:06 — Loose close-up of her face. She looks away and smiles naturally. Warm morning light, imperfect framing and exposure.

00:06–00:09 — Camera follows her into a narrow alley. She crouches and feeds a neighborhood cat near a house terrace. Plants, old walls, motorcycles and overhead cables in background.

00:09–00:12 — Side-angle shot. She smiles, raises her hand, waves and says, “Hai.” Camera reacts slightly late and reframes naturally.

00:12–00:15 — Side tracking shot as she walks and lights a cigarette. She glances at camera with a relaxed smile. Natural focus hunting.

00:15–00:18 — Low handheld shot following her feet as she walks. A small cat follows behind.

00:18–00:22 — In front of her house, she hangs freshly washed clothes on a clothesline. Morning breeze moves the clothes and hair. Imperfect handheld framing.

00:22–00:26 — Sitting on the front terrace, quietly drinking coffee and looking toward the street. Camera drifts from the side.

00:26–00:30 — Side-profile tracking shot as she walks with coffee. She notices the camera, looks toward it and smiles naturally. Focus shifts, then the footage abruptly cuts to black.

Environment: Quiet Indonesian residential street, simple houses, small terraces, plants, clothesline, parked motorcycles, large trees and tangled electrical cables. No shops or commercial activity.

Audio: Natural ambience only—birds, breeze, distant motorcycles, neighborhood sounds, cat sounds, footsteps, cup sounds and leaves. No music.
